finding: a cold-clone verify_all run on the acquisition host takes about nineteen minutes of wall time
why: A referee asked how long a reader's own run of the artifact's gate script takes. This record holds one timed run of bin/verify_all.sh on the acquisition host, so the paper can print the figure from a record rather than from memory.
generator: measured by hand: /usr/bin/time -f '%E' bash bin/verify_all.sh, 2026-09-02, on the acquisition host; not regenerated by CI
note: The run included the recovery oracle (lattice reductions inside the pinned image), the control suite and the paper gates; the paper gates were failing on page count during this run, which does not change the wall time materially. Concurrent paper builds ran during the timing, so the figure is an upper bound of a quiet run.
